long_biography.plain_text:
Tilman J. Fertitta began in construction and development before committing fully to restaurants. He invested in two Houston-area seafood restaurants, then gained control of Landry's in 1986. Fertitta expanded the company through a steady programme of acquisitions, took it public and later bought back the remaining shares, restoring sole private ownership.

Basketball became a second expression of his Houston roots. A former minority owner and unsuccessful bidder for the team, Fertitta acquired the Houston Rockets in 2017 after decades as a supporter. The franchise joined his privately held Fertitta Entertainment group, connecting a longstanding local ambition with the hospitality business he had built.
